No automático, o SuperFastFiles olha se: On automatic, SuperFastFiles checks whether source and destination are SSD, HDD, network or the same disk and picks threads and block size by itself. Only change this if you know what you're doing.
Não usar o cache do sistema nos arquivos: Don't use the system cache for large files

Muda os textos do programa e da linha de: Changes the language of the program and the command line (sff). Automatic = the system language.
Define a estratégia. Em HDD, ler e grava: Sets the strategy. On an HDD, reading and writing on the same disk at once is slow; on an SSD, the more parallel the better.
Quantos arquivos são copiados ao mesmo t: How many files are copied at the same time. 0 = automatic.
Quanto é lido/gravado por vez nos arquiv: How much is read/written at a time for large files. 0 = automatic (8 MB on SSD, 32 MB on the same HDD).
Como o FastCopy: arquivos grandes (32 MB: Like FastCopy: large files (32 MB or more) go straight from disk to disk without filling the system memory. Keeps the computer responsive during huge copies and is usually faster.
Windows: CopyFileEx (cópia no servidor e: Windows: CopyFileEx (server-side copy on networks and block cloning on ReFS/Dev Drive). Linux: reflink and copy_file_range. macOS: clonefile on APFS (instant).
